_doc: Test runner manifest (scripts/run-tests.cjs, Nov 10 2026). Every tests/*.cjs|*.mjs file runs unless listed in skip or tests/quarantine.json. The core set (npm run test:quiet -- --core) is every `node [flags] tests/x.cjs` named in package.json scripts.test (the old hand-kept chain, now inside TEST_CORE_CHAIN='...'; many tests assert they are named there, so keep adding new tests to it). flags = extra node flags per file. env = extra environment per file. noCache = run without the TypeScript transpile cache (timing-dependent tests), with the reason. extra = non-tests/ scripts that run as tests. serial = run one at a time after the pool (launch a browser or bind a port). skip = helpers in tests/ that are not tests.

noCache.tests/tennis-hold-power.cjs: 'haptics on press (rate limited)' only passes when >150 ms of transpiling separates two haptic() calls (performance.now rate limiter); with the cache it fails

skip.tests/water-tropical-glslcost.cjs: CLI helper (needs two file args), required by another test

_ciSkipDoc: ciSkip = tests dropped only when CI=true (GitHub Actions, .github/workflows/ci.yml): they need something a hosted Ubuntu runner lacks (dev server on :8092, Chrome, macOS tools). One-line reason each. Empty on Nov 10 2026: every core test passed with CI=true, the browser parts self-skip without their env vars, the runner-* suites get Node 24 via NODE22, and the Postgres parts use the runner's /usr/lib/postgresql. See docs/tooling/CI.md.
